details: 1.0.70 macOS /dev/cu.usbmodem: no reply to ID at 9600-57600. Notes say TH-75A (no PC programming) but the CDC port fits a TH-D75. Likely setup: KISS/TNC or GPS PC Output (Menu 405) on the USB port, another app holding the port, or a charge-only cable. Asked to confirm the model.
summary: No reply to ID on macOS USB (notes say TH-75A)
